text:
jen_partnerships: quick sync re: VaultStream MSSP bundle. Partner wants BYOK demo + SAML + SCIM flow for marketplace listing. They need a short integration runbook, smoke script, and 2 slides for the webinar by EOW. @samir_eng @lee_security can we commit?

samir_eng: I can do the smoke script. Clarify KMS: they asked for key-wrap (wrap/unwrap) for secret rotation, not signing. We'll run KMIP emulator in staging.

lee_security: ok treat as customer-managed KMS for Redwood Private. Confirm KeyWave KMIP support from VaultStream. Add CA thumbprint validation and note about avoiding long-lived provisioning tokens.

olivia_sales: VaultStream will provision a dev tenant and a non-prod KMIP endpoint (test certs). They asked for an integration checklist for service accounts and roles.

alex_ops: we have a KMIP emulator image (kmip-emu:latest). I'll hand off an AMI and cloudinit snippet for staging.

samir_eng: plan: 1) SAML metadata exchange (signed assertions example), 2) SCIM token + incremental group sync sample, 3) KMIP key-wrap handshake with emulator, 4) call Redwood rotate API to verify rotation. I'll post sanitized commands.

samir_eng: SCIM token example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.vaultstream.local/scim/token -d '{"client_id":"vs-dev","client_secret":"REDACTED"}'
```

samir_eng: rotate sample (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.staging.redwood-inference.local/v1/secrets/rotate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \
  -d '{"secret_id":"vs-demo","kms_key_id":"kmip://test-key"}'
```

deploy-bot: CI #vaultstream-integ smoke: 5 tests, 1 flaky (SCIM paging). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/9999 :white_check_mark:

samir_eng: flaky caused by large group pages. switching to incremental sync + backoff and idempotency header. will push script by Tue.

lee_security: include idempotency token header for provisioning ops and a rollback step: restore previous wrap key and mark secrets read-only on failures. Also add a short threat-model paragraph for the runbook.

maria_pm: I can draft the 1-pager and 2-slide deck if eng supplies commands and 2 screenshots by Wed.

jen_partnerships: action items: Samir (E2E smoke + script) Tue EOD; Alex (AMI + cloudinit) Tue AM; Olivia (partner dev tenant & certs) Wed AM; Lee (security blurb + rollback note) Wed EOD; Maria (runbook + slides) Wed EOD. Marketing needs assets Thu.

olivia_sales: nudging VaultStream for certs and roles now.

samir_eng: temp repo: https://git.internal/redwood/vs-integ (internal). will sanitize before external share.

jen_partnerships: great. we'll consolidate and share draft with VaultStream for review. Thanks everyone :rocket:
